Perception PID3895 is another major consumer:10.7G footprint,9.8G swapped regions,~1.5G resident mappings after15days running. This is a concrete maintenance candidate, not proof of a diagnosed memory leak.

Snapshot memory accounting is not additive: shared mappings may overlap, footprint includes compressed/swapped charges, and freeing a10.7G footprint does not promise10.7GiB additional resident headroom.
